behaviour: Test unread notifications home card rendering, mark-as-read, deep-link URL and table highlight handling, signal refresh, polling fallback, unmount cleanup, and legacy/alpha registrations.
rules: 1. Import only packages declared in plugins/notifications/package.json: { act, fireEvent, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react', { renderInTestApp, TestApiProvider } from '@backstage/test-utils', { signalApiRef, type SignalApi } from '@backstage/plugin-signals-react', { toastApiRef } from '@backstage/frontend-plugin-api', { Notification, NotificationSignal } from '@backstage/plugin-notifications-common', and local modules (do NOT import @testing-library/user-event or @backstage/frontend-test-utils).

2. Test that Content calls notificationsApi.getNotifications({ read: false, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc', limit: 5 }) and renders notification titles, descriptions, origins, topics, and links with href='/notifications?id=<id>'.
3. Test that Content renders 'No unread notifications' when getNotifications returns an empty array and renders ResponseErrorPanel when getNotifications rejects.

4. Test that clicking the 'Mark as read' button calls notificationsApi.updateNotifications({ ids: [id], read: true }) and removes that notification from the DOM; test that when updateNotifications rejects, toastApi.post is called with { title: 'Failed to mark notification as read', status: 'danger' } and the notification remains.

5. Test that when signalApiRef is provided, Content subscribes to the 'notifications' channel, re-fetches unread notifications when the subscriber callback receives a NotificationSignal, and calls unsubscribe when the component unmounts.

6. Test with jest.useFakeTimers() (cleaning up with jest.useRealTimers() in afterEach) that when signalApiRef is not provided, Content polls getNotifications at pollingIntervalMs and clears the interval on unmount so advancing timers after unmount triggers no further getNotifications calls.

7. Test that NotificationsTable and NotificationsPage rendered at initial route '/notifications?id=notif-1' apply aria-current='true' and the highlightedRow class to the matching notification row and do not apply them to non-matching rows or when rendered at '/notifications' without ?id=.

8. Test that HomePageUnreadNotifications exported from '../../plugin' renders the 'Unread notifications' card title and unread items, and that the default alpha plugin export from '../../alpha' registers extension 'home-page-widget:notifications/unread-notifications'.

style_from.reason: Follows Backstage test conventions using @testing-library/react screen and renderInTestApp from @backstage/test-utils.
